mapper.select: SELECT mo.order_id AS "orderId", mo.order_reference AS "orderReference", mo.merchant_reference AS "merchantReference", mo.account_id AS "accountId", mo.shopper_id AS "shopperId", mo.currency_id AS "currencyId", mo.net_amount AS "netAmount", mo.tax_amount AS "taxAmount", mo.gross_amount AS "grossAmount", mo.idempotency_key AS "idempotencyKey", mo.created_ts AS "createdAt" FROM merchant_order mo JOIN order_payment op ON op.order_id = mo.order_id WHERE op.payment_reference = #{paymentReference}

SELECT order_item_id AS "orderItemId", sequence, product_type_id AS "productTypeId", order_line_reference AS "orderLineReference", merchant_line_reference AS "merchantLineReference", net_amount AS "netAmount", tax_amount AS "taxAmount", tax_rate AS "taxRate" FROM order_item WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY sequence
SELECT psp.code AS "pspCode", op.psp_reference AS "pspReference" FROM order_payment op JOIN account psp ON psp.account_id = op.psp_account_id WHERE op.payment_reference = #{paymentReference}
